2511-7841--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Darksteel Angel
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

783-2174-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-2174-2645-3430.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

215-5295-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-5295-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

34-147-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-147-4247.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

539-728-3249-7968--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-7968--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

628-4247-7189.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

777-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

2034-2279-6718-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2279-6718-7654.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

3617-4125-7631.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1309-1987-4276-7487.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1309-1987-4276-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and Salvager of Secrets.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Salvager of Secrets enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-4276-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

116-1486-1753-7223.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
116-1486-1753-7223.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1445-2060-6413-7223.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2060-6413-7223.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

147-2034-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2577-2921-6462.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

225-774-5621.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway.
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-3062-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1308-3062-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

957-3982-5003.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Living Lore.
Living Lore does not have summoning sickness.
957-3982-5003.description:
Deal combat damage to a player or permanent using Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Living Lore dies, its reflexive ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Living Lore trigger, causing you to cast Time Stretch from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Living Lore from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
As Living Lore enters the battlefield, choose to exile Time Stretch from your graveyard.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2438-2724-3582-3987.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

407-1348-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Swamps.
407-1348-4657.description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Cabal Coffers's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {B} for each basic Swamp you control.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Cabal Coffers.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3194-5163.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Roon of the Hidden Realm. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1636-1756-2108-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 2.
1636-1756-2108-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Reservoir Walker.
When Reservoir Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Reservoir Walker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Reservoir Walker from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Reservoir Walker enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Reservoir Walker trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

4980-5037-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: Anje does not have summoning sickness.
4980-5037-5220-5256.description:
Activate Anje by tapping it and discarding Blazing Rootwalla.
Blazing Rootwalla is discarded into exile due to its madness ability.
Anje and Blazing Rootwalla trigger.
Resolve the Anje trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blazing Rootwalla trigger, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Blazing Rootwalla.
When Blazing Rootwalla dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Blazing Rootwalla on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Anje ability from step 1, causing you to draw Blazing Rootwalla from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2781-3086-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Lagrella.
Lagrella leaves the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile.
Lagrella and Felidar Guardian's enter-the-battlefield abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Felidar Guarrdian until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Lagrella.
Repeat from step 2.

457-4067-4639-5042.description:
Activate Urza by tapping Unctus, adding {U}.
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Urza to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Urza by tapping itself, adding {U}.
Urza triggers, causing you to draw two cards and discard a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Urza.
Repeat.

2420-4050-5150.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2420-4050-5150.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding one mana of any color.
Scuzzback Marauders dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Bramblewood Paragon.
Repeat.

813-1777-5100.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Return Upon the Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

730-1479-1671.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-1671.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
